purpose: Yield strategy that acquires/disposes ERC4626 vault SHARES via an AMM swap (IAMMAdapter/Curve) instead of vault.deposit()/redeem() — built for restricted vaults (sUSDe 7-day cooldown). Since the story-045/046 hoist this contract is a thin concrete: it implements only the yield-source hooks; ALL principal accounting lives in AYieldStrategy. Rebasing vaults unsupported; assumes share price only rises or stays flat.

story-047 (933620d): _skimSurplus L289-294: NEW loud guard — if totalBufferShares > 0 and setAsideBufferRecipient == address(0), revert 'AYieldStrategy: setAsideBufferRecipient not set'. Guard sits AFTER the single swap, but the revert unwinds the whole tx (no funds move; only a gas-waste quirk).

_distributeBuffer L353-372: REMOVED the per-client `underlyingToken.safeTransfer(clients[i], buf)` inside the loop; the loop now only SUMS totalSetAside, then ONE aggregate `safeTransfer(setAsideBufferRecipient, totalSetAside)` (L368). Remainder to `recipient` unchanged; rounding dust still favors recipient; return value still reduced by totalSetAside.
story-048 (ad12cb1): NO direct changes to this file. Inherits the 6h/72h totalWithdrawal timing from the base. The creditedPrincipal fix and the new preview functions apply ONLY to ERC4626YieldStrategy (out of scope) — this contract already credited a slippage-haircut principal (_creditedPrincipal, L106-108) and gains NO previewDeposit/previewRedeem (asymmetry note below).

trustAssumptions: vault is a well-behaved ERC4626 with monotone non-decreasing share price; convertTo* not manipulable within a block in a way that breaks minOut.
ammAdapter / Curve Router NG trusted to enforce minOut and report true output.
Owner sets a sane slippageToleranceBps post-deploy (default 0 is a deposit/withdraw DoS — carried).
Owner sets setAsideBufferRecipient BEFORE configuring any nonzero client buffer, or accepts that skims revert loudly until it is set (story-047 intended behavior).
setAsideBufferRecipient is a protocol-owned sink (intended: stable-staker) that correctly accounts for unsolicited ERC20 inflows — verification of the consumer side is an INTERACTION concern.
Authorized clients and withdrawers are protocol-owned contracts.

localFindings.description: story-048 added previewDeposit/previewRedeem to ERC4626YieldStrategy only; this market strategy exposes no preview surface even though its execution is AMM-priced (where a preview would arguably matter more, and where vault.preview* would be the WRONG oracle anyway). Not declared in IYieldStrategy, so no interface break — but a downstream integrator written against ERC4626YieldStrategy's preview functions will revert on this strategy. Deliberate-looking; flag for story-faithfulness to confirm story-048 scoped previews to the direct strategy on purpose.
localFindings.recommendation: If previews are wanted here, they must be AMM-quote based, not vault.preview* based; otherwise document the asymmetry.

localFindings.description: The aggregate buffer transfer to setAsideBufferRecipient emits no strategy-level event (only the token Transfer). SurplusSkimmed events still carry per-client SNAPSHOT surplus in vault-asset terms, so off-chain accounting cannot reconstruct the realized recipient-vs-buffer split from strategy events alone. Pre-existing gap made slightly wider by 047 (the buffer leg's destination changed and its amount is still unlogged).
localFindings.recommendation: Emit e.g. BufferSetAside(recipient, totalSetAside, toRecipient) in the buffered path.
